Senses.Explanation: To follow conditions, expansive and unconfined is a recurrent claim about freedom amid circumstances, but the records repeatedly test whether that claim names actual command or merely undisciplined drifting. Baiyu Si calls ranging through flower streets, song towers, and other circumstances true keeping of the precepts only for someone who has genuinely found an entry; elsewhere he says that even unconfined freedom still requires a further road of turning around. Dahui Zonggao likewise places the phrase after fulfilling ordinary obligations and immediately requires continual self-inspection within the four modes of conduct. Yongjue Yuanxian gives the formula its sharpest adverse control. He rejects people who cannot distinguish east from west yet call themselves expansive and unconfined, and then rejects merely continuing to repeat the formula without views. Sanshan Lai turns the expression into a public question; his seasonal answers do not convert it into permission to do whatever one wants, and he closes by saying it must not leave 'here.'
